name: hafez

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && esbuild src/graph/client/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/graph/client.js && node dist/graph/copy-fonts.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.install:local: chmod +x "$(pwd)/dist/cli.js" && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sf "$(pwd)/dist/cli.js" ~/.local/bin/hafez && for d in ~/.claude/skills ~/.agents/skills; do for s in hafez hafez-save; do mkdir -p "$d/$s" && cp "$(pwd)/skill/$s/SKILL.md" "$d/$s/SKILL.md"; done; done
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run typecheck

description: A knowledge and project vault shared between you and your agents — plain markdown + git, schema-enforced writes, FTS5 search, operated by agents through a CLI
